document_name: Spotify Terms and Conditions of Use

clauses.quote: Unless otherwise specified (for example, if you signed up for a Prepaid Period), Paid Subscriptions continue indefinitely until cancelled. You will be billed again on the first day of each billing period; you will make the relevant payment and authorize us (or the applicable third party if you signed up through a third party) to charge the then-current subscription fee to your payment method.
clauses.rationale: Subscription automatically renews indefinitely and recurs automatically without affirmative re-consent.

clauses.quote: Unless otherwise stated in these Terms, we do not offer refunds or credits for partial subscription periods.
clauses.rationale: Expressly denies refunds or credits for partial periods when canceling.

clauses.quote: Spotify may change the price of Paid Subscriptions, including recurring subscription fees, Prepaid Periods (for periods not yet paid for), or Codes (as defined above), from time to time and will notify you of any price changes a reasonable amount of time in advance.
clauses.rationale: Spotify reserves unilateral authority to alter subscription prices.

clauses.quote: Spotify, its officers, shareholders, employees, representatives, directors, affiliates, subsidiaries, successors, officers, suppliers, or licensors shall in no event be liable for: (1) any indirect, special, incidental, punitive, exemplary, or consequential damages of any kind
clauses.rationale: Broad disclaimer of all indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages.

clauses.quote: You and Spotify agree that any dispute, claim, or conflict between you and Spotify arising in any way in connection with these Agreements or your relationship with Spotify as a user of the Service (whether based on contract, tort, law, fraud, misrepresentation, or any other legal theory, regardless of whether the claim arises during or after the term of the Agreements) shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration.
clauses.rationale: Mandates binding individual arbitration for virtually all disputes, waiving court access.

clauses.quote: TO THE EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, YOU AND SPOTIFY AGREE THAT YOU MAY ONLY STAND AS EACH OTHER IN ANY CASE THAT APPEARS TO BE A CLASSIFICATION OR REPRESENTATIVE ACTION, AND NOT AS A PLAINTIFF OR PARTY TO A CLASSIFICATION ACTION.
clauses.rationale: Strict waiver barring consumers from participating in class or representative actions.
